title: Crüger to Müller, 20/30 September 1634
author: Peter Crüger
source: Peter Crüger's letter to Philipp Müller written at Danzig on 20/30 September 1634, on Müller's suggestion that he buy the posthumous papers of Kepler and Bartsch from their widows for the city of Danzig. The original is in the Bibliothèque de l'Observatoire, Paris (B, 1, 9; 89, 9. Aa. 47). Printed in extracts in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 111.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Crüger cannot afford to buy the posthumous papers of Kepler and Bartsch from their widows himself, and the Danzig council is taken up with the Swedish truce.

notes.on: the truce is now drawing to its end
notes.note: The truce of Altmark (1629) between Sweden and Poland, due to expire in 1635; it was renewed at Stuhmsdorf in September 1635.
